video_title: N3on Meets NBA Legend Kevin Garnett!

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his defensive approach against Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't dare try to back Shaq down. Shaq's bigger than me.
quotes.quote: Everybody has a profile. If you're going to play Shaq, you probably want to play him the same way you play him. I wouldn't dare try to back Shaq down. Shaq's bigger than me. Shaq's bigger than everybody in here, though. You understand? That's the reality part of this. I would try to face him and I would use more guard skills against Shaq, getting him to move laterally, and I would use that as a pump fake.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on the defensive prowess of Cliff Robinson
quotes.excerpt: Cliff Robinson was probably one of the best defenders I've ever had.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say I couldn't do anything, but it was difficult. A guy by the name of Cliff Robinson. Cliff Robinson was probably one of the best defenders I've ever had. He was gritty, he could move laterally. You remember when the famous Michael Jordan when he goes like this in the game because he hit six threes? Cliff Robinson was guarding him. Cliff Robinson had a red headband around his head. He kind of looked the same when Michael said, 'What the fuck, I can't stop this motherfucker.' But Cliff Robinson was probably one of the best defenders I've ever had.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's preference for coaching the Portland Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: If I could coach a team, Portland. I like Portland.
quotes.quote: I would never coach, but if I could coach a team, Portland. I like Portland.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on why the Portland Trail Blazers should keep their smalls
quotes.excerpt: When I saw Portland didn't trade Jrue Holiday and they didn't trade none of their smalls.
quotes.quote: When I saw Portland didn't trade Jrue Holiday and they didn't trade none of their smalls, they kept all them guards. You know why? Because you got to have guard play to beat the Spurs. You got to have guard play to beat OKC.
